scope: Descriptive complete first-pass atlas for every accepted extension02 V2 event. No origin labels from 1D and no modification of production or previous results.
selection: All rows of extension02/production/V2_HITS.csv in saved candidate order; zero rows handled explicitly. Preserve candidate_id and all production origin_status=UNREVIEWED.

atlas.data: Saved 1D samples at seed_index +/-50; subtract saved linear sideband intercept+slope, divide by saved sideband MAD; preserve NaNs and nonpositive/missing scale flags.
atlas.model: Overlay saved fixed Gaussian using saved amplitude/MAD, fitted center and model FWHM; no refit, shifts or width changes.
atlas.labels: Candidate ID, target, date, barycentric air center, A/MAD, profile cosine; scores explicitly not calibrated significance.
atlas.coverage: Every accepted event gets a panel, even if plot data incomplete; missing metadata or ranges recorded, never silently dropped.

old_match.include: All old333 accepted hits within the fixed window; store all matching old review IDs, offsets, exposures, minimum distance, original peer status only as linked context.
old_match.interpretation: Descriptive repeat-position relation between already-selected hits, not independent validation, raw-origin confirmation, or an all-epoch comparison. Missing match does not imply absence in other epochs.

existing_two_line_policy.meaning: The original two-line descriptive flag remains separate and unchanged.

separate_posthoc_extension.meaning: Posthoc hypothesis motivated by original0205 followup; separate column, not inserted into original two-line flag.

oi_flags.transform: Approximate classical topocentric=lambda_bary/(1+BERV/299792.458). Air-line proximity is not an origin label or rejection.

summaries: Counts by target, exposure, fixed 100-Angstrom wavelength bins, and original two-line/posthoc6363 flags. Expose all denominators; no aggregate sensitivity or prevalence claims.
followup_routes: No old accepted-hit match and no OI proximity: prioritize native-order/raw morphology and full-epoch checks.
Old accepted-hit match: compare existing raw/epoch context, then inspect this exposure independently.
OI proximity: inspect simultaneous sky fiber/calibration, multi-line and all-epoch context.
visual_review: Visually inspect every atlas panel; describe gross 1D patterns and gaps without detector/airglow/stellar origin labels.
checks: Hash inputs; verify expected accepted candidate IDs exactly match panels/index; independently reproduce deterministic first/middle/last candidate plots and matching/flag scalars in a fresh process; verify production dispositions remain byte-identical.
prohibited: No new detector, threshold tuning, downloads, contacts, production-status changes, null conclusion, or independent-significance claim.
